text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Jordanian press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Parliament votes during a heated session that lasted four hours in favour of the single vote electoral system.

- Palestinian leader Arafat due in Amman on Monday to discuss latest political developments in the region; phones king to congratulate him on leaving hospital after successful treatment to a painful knee.
- Saudi foreign minister expected in Amman in mid-next month.
- Kabariti says in published remarks that King Hussein's latest visit to Saudi Arabia was successful and constructive and "praises efforts of Saudi King Fahd in support of Arab causes".
- Amman will be divided into 60 areas to ensure a just distribution of water during the summer; a programme to renew the water pipeline system to prevent leakages by year 2000.
- Syrian intelligence release Jordanian hotel executive who was kidnapped three weeks ago in Beirut.
- 1993 temporary election law endorsed by parliament with 51 votes, 21 against and 4 abstentions.
